summary_en: Trend Micro will acquire up to 917,600 shares (0.70% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥5.0 billion through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13 to December 23, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Trend Micro Incorporated announced on November 12, 2026 that its Board of Directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 917,600 treasury shares, representing 0.70% of outstanding shares, for a maximum expenditure of ¥5.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13 to December 23, 2026, on a contract date basis.

The company stated that treasury stock acquisition is prioritized alongside dividends as a shareholder return method. The acquisition is intended to optimize the level of cash on hand held by the company, thereby improving the efficiency of shareholder capital, and to enable flexible capital policy implementation in response to changing business environments.

As of October 31, 2026, the company held 10,732,032 treasury shares against 130,169,572 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
